attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, c.callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols caller ON caller.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols callee ON callee.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = caller.file_id JOIN code.files pf ON pf.file_id = callee.file_id WHERE cf.package LIKE '%click%' AND cf.file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND caller.kind IN ('function','method') AND callee.kind IN ('function','method') AND c.call_kind = 'reference' AND c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL

request:
Inside the bodies of functions and methods in the click library (src/click/), where is a module-level function or a method defined in the repository passed by reference as an argument to another call (so the receiving call is expected to invoke it) rather than being called at that point? Module-level code outside any function, and nested helper functions, do not count. Give the symbol ID of the function or method containing the call and the symbol ID of the function passed, one row per distinct pair.

Requested output columns: passing_symbol_id (string), passed_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Joins calls to symbols and files, restricting callers to functions/methods in src/click/ and callees to repository-defined functions/methods, and selects calls whose kind is a reference (passed as an argument) rather than a direct invocation. Returns distinct caller/callee symbol ID pairs.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, c.callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols caller ON caller.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols callee ON callee.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = caller.file_id JOIN code.files pf ON pf.file_id = callee.file_id WHERE cf.package LIKE '%click%' AND cf.file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND caller.kind IN ('function','method') AND callee.kind IN ('function','method') AND c.call_kind = 'reference' AND c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
